# Deploy lanes: the one place that says which files are admin work.
#
# Decision 2026-10-09 (Fredrik, ex-tales-forge docs/decisions.md "A fast
# deploy lane for admin work"). Read by TalesForge.DeployLanes:
#   - .github/workflows/playtest.yml picks the lane of each merge to main
#     (.github/scripts/deploy_lane.exs),
#   - `mix deploy.check_boundaries` (CI Test job) fails when game or shared code
#     depends on an [admin] file,
#
# Lanes:
#   admin   Every file changed since the commit production runs is on [admin]:
#           deploy to playtest AND production automatically (no Gentry/batch
#           gate, no prod OK). Production still goes through deploy-production.yml's
#           "Verify commit" job and the tip-of-main guard.
#   security  A dependency bump that fixes a published advisory (decision
#           2026-10-11 "Security-bump lane"; TalesForge.DeployLanes.Security,
#           .github/scripts/security_lane.exs). The PR changes only mix.lock (and
#           version pins in mix.exs), every package keeps its major version, the
#           PR has the label `security` or the title prefix `security:` and an
#           advisory id (CVE, GHSA, EEF-CVE), and CI is green. security-lane.yml
#           merges it; playtest.yml deploys playtest, runs the smoke check and
#           deploys production for that sha, then notifies Bobby. No founder OK.
#           This file has no [security] section: the rules are in the module.
#   normal  Anything else (game, shared, CI, docs, unknown files; a mixed merge):
#           playtest first; a founder's Approve ships it to production.
#
# Format: one pattern per line under a [section]; `#` starts a comment.
#   path/to/file.ex   exactly that file
#   path/to/dir/      everything under that directory
#   *  and  **        any characters within one path segment / across segments
# Paths are relative to the repo root. Renames count as delete + add, so moving
# a file onto or off the list counts both paths.
#
# Keep this list narrow. A file belongs here only if production may get its
# changes without Gentry or the playtest batch: it must not be game engine code
# (Game.*, intent, world, NPCs, rules, packs) or shared code (sign-in, Repo and
# migrations, config, AICalls, mix.exs/deps, the router, CI, this file).

[admin]
# The founders' idea board (production only; design-idea-board.md). The shared
# contract (TalesForge.BoardApi), its controller, route and the board tables'
# migrations are [wiring]/shared, not here.

lib/ex_tales_forge/surveys.ex
lib/ex_tales_forge/survey/

lib/ex_tales_forge_web/components/survey_components.ex
lib/ex_tales_forge_web/controllers/survey_export_controller.ex
priv/surveys/
test/ex_tales_forge/surveys_test.exs
test/ex_tales_forge/survey/
test/ex_tales_forge_web/admin/survey_live_test.exs
test/support/survey_fixtures.ex

[wiring]
# Shared files that may name [admin] modules because they mount them: the
# router (routes), the application (supervised caches and the PR feed poller)
# and the GET /internal/costs controller (it serves costs data; its token check
# is TalesForge.AppRole.peer_token/0, shared). Every other shared file must not depend on
# [admin] files either (`mix deploy.check_boundaries`).
lib/ex_tales_forge_web/router.ex
lib/ex_tales_forge/application.ex
